proposals.before: His two sons, Dilede and Nianjing, both submitted to execution.
proposals.after: His two sons, Dilede and Nianjing, were both executed.
proposals.reason: 伏誅 means were executed; “submitted to execution” is an unnatural calque that obscures the meaning.

decisions.reason: For the literal field, 皆伏誅 is already rendered accurately by the calque “both submitted to execution”; the names, sonship, and death outcome match 二子：的裏得、念經，皆伏誅. Replacing it with “were both executed” only restyles the same sense already given in the idiomatic line.
